function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a ProDOS file; use offset to page

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a ProDOS file. type TXT (.MD notes), BAS (Applesoft listing with line numbers), or BIN. Always use this instead of printing a whole program.

function.name: create_bin
function.description: Write a BIN/SYS file from hex bytes; auxtype is the load address
